title: Fix SSE streaming partial-JSON delimiter ordering and token/event framing edge cases
author: Samantha Li
commits: normalize: sanitize SSE 'data:' framing before parsing partial JSON tokens
fix: ensure delimiter order preserved when emitting partial-json and token events
test: add unit + integration tests for interleaved token/event ordering and partial JSON fragments
docs: update OpenAI compatibility notes about SSE partial-json edge cases
description: Context: Customers and internal load tests exposed a class of edge cases where SSE streaming would occasionally emit events with the delimiter/token ordering reversed when partial-JSON mode and token-event framing were enabled (OpenAI-compat streaming adapter). This resulted in invalid partial JSON being reassembled by clients and intermittent parsing failures in downstream SDKs. Motivation: make SSE output stable and spec-compatible for partial JSON streams, avoid client-side parsing breaks, and ensure back-compat with the existing OpenAI-compat adapter. Summary of changes: 1) moved delimiter normalization into a single streaming layer (sse_streamer.py) so all downstream adapters see canonical framing; 2) adjusted partial_json_parser to treat 'data:' frames and meta tokens as first-class fragments, preserving original token/event order across flushes and reconnects; 3) updated openai_compat/sse_adapter to stop reordering tokens when it interleaves partial-json and non-json events; 4) added unit tests that fuzz message boundaries and verify reassembly invariants; 5) added integration tests exercising the hosted API end-to-end with both token/event framing and partial-json enabled; 6) docs note about how clients should treat trailing delimiters; 7) added metrics (streaming.reassembly_errors and streaming.partial_json_latency) and an alert rule to catch regressions. Backwards compatibility: behavior is backwards-compatible for well-formed streams but fixes cases where earlier code produced invalid orderings. Testing: CI runs full unit + integration matrix; local stress harness reproduced the issue and validated the fix. Rollout plan: merged to main, will cherry-pick hotfix to release/2024-11-xx if any post-merge regressions are observed. Related: references SUP-1024 (customer incident), ENG-2345 (batching/streaming task), and a follow-up for SDK-side parsing hardening. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] metrics emitted [x] docs updated [x] changelog/release notes.

Priya Kapoor: CI initially failed flakily on the SSE reconnect test; added small sleep and tightened event assertions in test_token_event_framing.py — tests stabilized.
Ethan Zhou (approval): Looks good overall. The metrics + alert are critical; approved pending one nit about a log line level changed to DEBUG.
Samantha Li: Addressed nit and squashed debug->info->debug adjustment; ready to merge.
release_notes: Fixes an edge case in SSE streaming where partial-JSON + token/event framing could be emitted in incorrect delimiter/token order causing client parse errors. Adds tests, metrics, and documentation clarifications.
